summary: Frontend-only test of redesigned Shipment Detail (light tabbed layout) + related list page. Executed full end-to-end Playwright coverage of all data-testids listed in the request across list, detail (hero/stepper/facts), Overview, Booking & payment (SI edit + prepayment), Conversation (seed msgs, send, badge), Documents (CoO toggle), Activity, back navigation, completed shipment IS-0007 variant, and mobile 390px overflow check. 100% of assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ShipmentDetail.tsx (~200 lines) is dense/inline — readable now but nearing the point where extracting each tab into its own component would help maintainability.

seedMsgs uses hard-coded times ('9:27 PM', '9:31 PM', '12:49 AM') and the activity list reuses fmt(s.created) with hard-coded time suffixes — cosmetic, but activity 'Customer message sent' at 3:29 AM is not tied to any real interaction.

The tab-conversation badge shows msgs.length instead of an unread count; documents tab badge is generated.length + 1 (accounts for packing xlsx). Both are functionally fine but the '+1' is a magic number.

Next-step chip logic: uses stages[s.stage + 1] with map { Shipped, Invoiced, Released }. 'Released' key is never hit because when stage < 5 the next stage after Pre-payment(3) is Released(4) — correct — but the map should ideally include all future stages for completeness.
test_credentials: Mock login: click 'Log in' with empty fields (as specified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: App uses popstate for hash navigation, not hashchange. Do NOT set window.location.hash via evaluate() after login — it won't trigger the router. Instead click the sidebar 'Shipments' link (get_by_role('link', name='Shipments')). Login is via 'Log in' button (lowercase 'in') with empty fields.
